title: Cryptolet - ESP32 Crypto Ticker & Portfolio Hardware
summary: Custom ESP32-based handheld and desktop hardware ticker with color TFT LCD displaying live cryptocurrency prices, multi-exchange candlestick charts, and captive portal Wi-Fi configuration.
highlights: Dual-core 240MHz ESP32 firmware written in C++ rendering real-time candlestick charts, moving averages, and multi-currency portfolio tracking.
Integrated SoftAP captive portal and SPIFFS flash filesystem for seamless over-the-air Wi-Fi and custom API endpoint setup.
Hardware user interface featuring tactile push-buttons, low-latency JSON REST parsing, and NTP time synchronization.
